services.title: Our services
services.lead: We build professional AI systems tailored to your business, not isolated features or generic templates.

diagnostic.title: Process diagnosis
diagnostic.body: We map how your business works today, step by step: what each person does, the order things happen in, and where time, information or customers get lost. You leave with a concrete plan of what to reorder, what to automate first and what to leave alone, whether you hire us or not.

chatbots.title: Chatbots
chatbots.body: A chatbot trained on your business answers pricing, hours and frequently asked questions in seconds, day and night. Someone who asks at 11pm gets an answer at 11pm, not the next morning.

automation.title: Process automation
automation.body: The repetitive work your team does by hand today: booking and confirming appointments, following up with the customer who asked and never came back, and recording every conversation and contact in a single panel. It runs on its own, with nobody having to remember.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.body: A step beyond a chatbot: the agent does not just answer, it acts. It checks your calendar, books the appointment, updates the customer record and hands off to a person when the case calls for it.

websites.title: Professional websites
websites.body: We design and build your full site: home, services, portfolio and a contact form that lands straight in your WhatsApp. Fast, search-ready, and built so a visit ends in a conversation.

pricing.title: Clear plans and pricing
pricing.lead: Two transparent figures you know before signing: a one-time implementation and a monthly fee for ongoing support. No fine print, no lock-in contracts.

one.question: How long does it take to set up and start using?
one.answer: Between 10 and 20 business days depending on scope. To start we need three things from you: access to your WhatsApp Business, your catalogue or service list with prices, and the questions your customers ask most. While we build, your operation carries on unchanged: nothing is switched off or migrated until the system has been tested and you have approved it.

two.question: What happens if the agent cannot answer something, or the customer gets angry?
two.answer: It escalates to someone on your team. We define the handoff triggers with you: when the customer asks for a person, when a complaint or a sensitive word comes up, when the question falls outside scope, or when the agent is not confident enough. On handoff, your colleague receives the full conversation and replies with the context already read. You also see every conversation in a panel and can step in whenever you want — it is not a black box.

three.question: What does it cost, and what exactly does the price include?
three.answer: There are two figures and you know both before signing. A one-off implementation, covering the diagnosis, the build, loading your information, the agreed integrations and testing until it works. And a monthly fee, covering hosting, monitoring, response tuning and support. The only separate cost is the per-message fee WhatsApp charges, which is paid to Meta and varies with your volume; we estimate it from your own numbers in the proposal. We do not charge for minor changes or for fixing something that is our fault.

four.question: Do I need technical knowledge or an IT team to maintain it?
four.answer: No. What you do is reply when a conversation is escalated to you, just as you answer a WhatsApp message today. To change a price, an opening time or an answer, you use a panel — no code — and we show you how at handover. Bugs, updates and platform changes are ours to handle, and they are covered by the monthly fee.

five.question: Does it work with the tools I already use (CRM, WhatsApp Business, calendar)?
five.answer: Today we connect WhatsApp Business API, Google Calendar and Outlook, Google Sheets, HubSpot and web forms, plus anything that exposes an open API. If you use something that is not on that list, we check it during the diagnosis and tell you whether it can be connected, with what limits, or whether another route makes more sense — before you hire us, not after.

six.question: What if I want to cancel, or it stops being useful?
six.answer: You can cancel whenever you like with 30 days notice. There is no minimum term and no exit penalty. Your data is yours: on closing we hand over the conversation history and the contacts captured in a format you can open and take with you, and we delete whatever remains on our side if you ask us to.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Numi AI collects, uses and protects the personal data it receives through its contact form.
privacy.intro: Numi AI collects personal data solely through the contact form on this site. This policy explains what data we receive, what we use it for and how you can request its deletion, in compliance with Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012.
privacy.dataIntro: Only the data you type into the form:

data.four: The description of what you need

privacy.useIntro: For two purposes, and no others:

use.one: To contact you in order to schedule and hold the strategy call you requested.
use.two: To assess your case and prepare a proposal suited to your operation.

privacy.sharing: Nobody. We do not sell, transfer or share your data with third parties, and we do not use it for advertising or to build profiles.
privacy.retention: We keep your data for as long as there is an active commercial conversation with you. If you ask us to delete it, we do.
privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights and how to exercise them
privacy.rights: You may ask us at any time to tell you what data of yours we hold, to correct it, or to delete it entirely. We respond within the timeframes set by law.
